_README: Starter egress allowlist for the agentic delivery pipeline. INERT in this repo —
copy the 'sandbox' object into <cyrus-home>/config.json at bootstrap.
This is the CORE list: the pipeline's own dependencies plus the universal source
and package hosts. It is deliberately NOT the union of every ecosystem — an
allowlist that allows everything is a comment, not a control. Add your stack's
hosts from the per-ecosystem menu in docs/EGRESS.md.
MECHANICS THAT BITE (all measured, see docs/EGRESS.md):
* Deny-by-default is triggered by the PRESENCE of 'allow'. Omitting networkPolicy,
or setting it to {}, is ALLOW-ALL, silently.
* Values must be arrays of objects: "host": [{}]. A list of strings will not parse.
* Wildcards work but exclude the apex: *.example.com matches sub.example.com and
NOT example.com. List both when you need both.
* 'subnets' rules parse but are NOT enforced.
* The policy is global, not per-repository.
VERIFY IT PARSED. The config is never schema-validated; a typo produces silence and
an open policy. The daemon's startup banner is the only signal:
[EgressProxy] Policy: deny-all with N allowed domain(s)   <- correct
[EgressProxy] Policy: allow-all (no domain restrictions)  <- it did not parse
TO DISABLE the network filter while keeping filesystem confinement, delete the
whole 'networkPolicy' key. Do NOT set enabled:false unless you also mean to drop
the filesystem sandbox. See docs/EGRESS.md for when disabling is the right call —
it usually is on a VM or dedicated host, and usually is not on a machine you also
use yourself.
This key is ignored by the reader and exists only so the file can carry its own
instructions; JSON has no comments.
